Cost Allowability

From the ORA eTraining module "Post Award Quick Guide" (lesson 3 of 9).
Budgeting Costs Budgeting for all aspects of your project can be a challenge. Please review the list below and check to see if you have included these items in your budget (where applicable). There may be items that are allowable under the terms of the award, but not budgeted for in your award.
Types of Activity
Description Banner (Budget Line) Budgeted for Documentation Allowable Documentation Release time 01 Other full-time employment 01 Summer salary 02 Contractual employment 02 Student work 02 Honoraria 02 Communications 03 Domestic travel 04 International travel 04 Contractual work (outside MSU) 08 Consultants 08 Subawards 08 Supplies (<$5,000 each) 09 Equipment (>$5,000 each) 11 Student stipends 12 Tuition assistance 12 Other Other
For those items that are budgeted for, please review the relevant section of PI Handbook #3: Grant-Related Processes, starting on page 23. The most current version of the PI Handbooks can be found here .
Complete the content above before moving on.
Troublesome Expenses & Transactions The PI and other team members are responsible for maintaining fiscal compliance in all matters. Special emphasis needs to be paid attention to certain issues that may easily trigger audit. Test your acumen below in a troublesome expenses matching game.
Which Expenses are Risky?
conference registration
alcoholic beverages
lab supplies
release time
recurring food (e.g. for a weekly meeting)
substantial budget transfer to travel
substantial end of project spending
excessive cost transfers
clerical/administrative salaries
general office supplies
paying employees beyond their institutional base salary
fines or penalties
bad debt write-offs
summer contracts for faculty
cost overruns
commencement/convocation costs
charitable contributions
alumni activities
society membership or dues
unfulfilled cost share
participant support (stipends/tuition remission)
building renovation
